title: Play Store availability?
symptom: xDrip+ is not available on the Google Play Store, which prevents installation on phones with Android for Work/Android Enterprise policies that disallow installing from external sources.
cause: The thread discusses various reasons: Google Play Store restrictions (e.g., requirement to target latest SDK versions, restrictions on sending text messages), potential FDA restrictions, and costs/update difficulties. However, no single root cause is definitively established.
fix: No resolution is provided. The maintainer (jamorham) states that standard side-loading is efficient and does not see an advantage to providing a stripped-down version for app stores. He mentions investigating the 'unreleased apps' section but no concrete fix is given.
evidence_quote: Google play store apps are subject to many restrictions, for example it is a requirement to target the latest sdk versions/libraries even though that will likely break the app which is why I don't do it.
